
# Generic Metadata Array Item

An element of an array-valued metadata property: a string, number, boolean, or null. Nested objects and nested arrays are not allowed.

## Data Type

`string|null|int|float|bool`

## Cases

| Type |
|  --- |
| `?string` |
| `int` |
| `float` |
| `bool` |

## ?string

### Initialization Code

#### Example

```php
$value = 'sale';
```

## int

### Initialization Code

#### Example

```php
$value = 10;
```

## float

### Initialization Code

#### Example

```php
$value = 10.5;
```

## bool

### Initialization Code

#### Example

```php
$value = true;
```
